summary: The compatibility baseline pins name the release archives under the renamed repository, so the published-release freshness check passes again.

replay.detail: No claim, replay or projection change; CI configuration and its test only.

rules.detail: No rule, permission or trust change.

compatibility.detail: The pinned archives and their SHA-256 digests are unchanged; only the URL's repository name changes.

downtime.detail: Nothing runs differently on installed machines.

recovery.detail: Revert the commit to restore the old URLs.
